name: openmathtutor
description: OpenMathTutor - interactive math whiteboard tutor (bring-your-own AI subscription)

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/frontend && npm run build -w packages/bridge
scripts.lint: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w packages/frontend && npm run lint -w packages/bridge
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/frontend && npm run typecheck -w packages/bridge
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/frontend && npm run test -w packages/bridge
